grade.primary_choice: Off-the-shelf class booking SaaS, set up by the agent
unsupported_claims: Puts Walla and Zen Planner on the shortlist next to budget tools without saying they usually cost well over 30 USD a month
Says a custom build 'could cost about 0–30 USD a month', which ignores the cost of paying the agent for ongoing upkeep
grade.notes: This is a strong, well-reasoned recommendation to buy a service rather than build one, with good coverage of capacity limits, trials, hidden fees, data export, privacy and the agent's limits. Points come off because it never tells the owner to open the account in their own name, it keeps a custom build as a softened fallback, and it lists some studio platforms that cost more than the budget without warning about it.
